faq.description: Everything you need to know about working with Innovazy, all in one place.

questions.a: Innovazy specializes in Odoo development, customization, implementation, and ERP solutions tailored to streamline business operations.

questions.q: What is Odoo and how can it help my business?
questions.a: Odoo is an all-in-one business management platform that integrates CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, HR, and more to improve efficiency and productivity.

questions.q: Do you provide custom Odoo module development?
questions.a: Yes, we develop custom Odoo modules based on your unique business requirements to ensure seamless workflow automation.

questions.q: Can you customize existing Odoo modules?
questions.a: Yes, we can modify and extend existing Odoo modules to better fit your processes and business needs.

questions.q: How long does an Odoo implementation take?
questions.a: The timeline depends on the complexity of the system and requirements, but most implementations are completed within a few weeks with structured planning.

questions.q: Do you offer Odoo integration with third-party tools?
questions.a: Yes, we integrate Odoo with third-party systems such as payment gateways, APIs, and external platforms to enhance functionality.

questions.q: Will I receive support after implementation?
questions.a: Yes, we provide ongoing support and maintenance to ensure your Odoo system runs smoothly and stays up to date.

questions.q: Do you help migrate data to Odoo?
questions.a: Yes, we assist in secure and accurate data migration from your existing systems to Odoo without disrupting your operations.

questions.q: Is Odoo suitable for small businesses?
questions.a: Yes, Odoo is highly scalable and works efficiently for startups, small businesses, and large enterprises alike.

questions.q: How can I get started with Innovazy?
questions.a: You can get started by reaching out through the contact section, and we will guide you through the consultation and onboarding process.
